name: Abounding
overview: Scripture reveals that abounding is a dynamic expression of the believer’s spiritual life, marked by growth and perseverance in faith. Paul prays that believers may abound in hope through the power of the Holy Spirit (Romans 15:13), and exhorts them to let their love increase in knowledge and discernment (Philippians 1:9). The Christian life involves learning to abound in all circumstances, whether in plenty or in need (Philippians 4:12), while being firmly rooted and established in faith, continually abounding in thanksgiving (Colossians 2:7). Together, these verses show abounding as a Christ-centered, Spirit-empowered flourishing that encompasses hope, love, endurance, and gratitude.
